name: Astral-Howe
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.

The terrain around escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
